text:
Rhea Patel: Postmortem follow-up: last night's eviction surge during bulk-loads. Need owners for runbook edits, alerting, and an RFC for job gating.
Noah Green: I'll take runbook + quick playbook cheat-sheet. ETA Tue EOD.
Noah Green: Suggested immediate triage commands to include:
```bash
# node and pod mem
kubectl top nodes | sort -k3 -nr
kubectl top pods -n inference | grep kv-cache
# recent evictions
curl -s 'http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum(increase(redis_evicted_keys_total[5m]))'
```
Tess: alert-bot created INC-2467 and linked a runbook draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/67
alert-bot: Created Jira INC-2467: "Runbook + alert for nightly eviction spikes" assigned to Noah Green, due 2026-04-06.
Ethan: I'll own the Prometheus alert and dashboard panel. Will propose thresholds by Fri.
Rhea Patel: Owners summary for INC-2467: runbook/playbook: Noah Green (due 2026-03-31); alert/dashboard: Ethan (due 2026-04-02); RFC for job gating: Rhea (due 2026-04-08). Add escalation: infra-oncall -> platform -> SRE lead.
Noah Green: I'll add explicit mitigation steps: scale batch_size, rotate cache pods, failover route. Include copy/paste commands.
Tess: I'll review the PR and add an oncall cheatsheet. Thanks all.
